title: TICK stage 2: run run_reconciliation_tick on its own thread at a 60 s cadence, serialized with entry dispatch by a journal_sync lock (removes ~28 s from the trader tick)
note: [from TICK-DURATION-115S, docs/research/tick-duration-115s-profile-2026-11-04.md section 6] MEASURED 2026-11-04 tick_cost (37 ticks): order_monitor reconciliation half 28.4 s per tick on the main loop. A plain move off-thread is UNSAFE: the reverse reconciler's default ORPHAN_POSITION_POLICY=adopt acts on first sight, and package->trade row takes up to 7.6 s (audit F8, n=40), so a concurrent pass could adopt a duplicate of a fill the main thread has not journaled. Design: one journal_sync lock held by Coordinator.multi_account_execute (place+journal) and by each reconciliation pass (preserves today's invariant); entries wait <= one pass only when a pass is in flight. Needs a replay/equivalence test over recorded ticks. Sweep cadence must stay bounded (60 s), never stopped (Prime Directive). DETECTOR: tick_cost order_monitor ~0 on-loop and tick mean < 40 s over >= 20 ticks.
